question: A contractor has multiple associates that will require access to the Internet using your Wi-Fi. They must be limited to only communicate with each other. In this scenario, what would be used to accomplish this task? A. RADIUS PSK B. Cloud PSK C. WPA-2/PSK D. Personal WLAN

A client calls you to troubleshoot possible interference with your wireless network. Before you drive to the customer’s site to investigate, you want to quickly verify if there is actually any interference at all. In this scenario, which SLE is responsible for this interference? A. coverage B. roaming C. throughput D. capacity

You have four actions presented to you by Marvis. Three of these actions are found under the AP category. Upon inspecting the category, you notice that the sub-categories in the AP category contain a lock symbol so that you cannot select any of the sub-categories to view the root cause. In this scenario, which statement is correct? A. It takes more time for the root cause report to be prepared by Marvis Actions. B. You need to enable Marvis Minis. C. A subscription is needed. D. The issue was identified as an AP issue, but Marvis Actions could not find the actual root cause.
Click the Exhibit button. Referring to the exhibit, which client has the weakest connection to the WLAN? A. Client 2 B. Client 4 C. Client 3 D. Client 1
You want to set the acceptable minimum RSSI for client devices. Which WLAN feature is needed to accomplish this task? A. WLAN forwarding B. geofencing C. WLAN rate limit D. wireless traffic filtering

Which statement correctly describes adjacent channel interference (ACI)? A. ACI has two or more access points operating on non-overlapping channels. B. ACI has two or more access points operating on overlapping channels. C. ACI has two or more access points operating on the same channel. D. ACI has two or more access points operating on the 2.4 GHz band.
Juniper Mist events are filtered into which three categories? (Choose three.) A. organization B. AP C. security D. client E. site

Which two statements correctly describe the Wi-Fi location component of Juniper Mist’s location-based services? (Choose two.) A. It tracks third-party BLE tags. B. It is included in the Wireless Assurance subscription. C. It is enabled by default. D. It requires the Asset Visibility subscription.
Which two statuses are displayed on the Juniper Mist subscription page? (Choose two.) A. Demo B. Exceed C. Valid D. Active

You are asked to clone your Juniper Mist primary site configuration to use for a new site being added. In this scenario, which two configuration objects will be copied? (Choose two.) A. the Auto Firmware Upgrade settings B. the RF templates C. the site location D. the WLANs
Which Juniper AP is used to augment BLE coverage? A. BT11 B. AP12 C. AP24 D. AP34
Which policy would you use to allow or deny user access to resources? A. WLAN template B. access list C. RF template D. WxLAN

You want to review the roaming activity of a specific wireless client. In this scenario, which two Marvis features would you use to accomplish this task? (Choose two.) A. Marvis Actions B. Marvis Minis C. Marvis Query Language D. Marvis Virtual Network Assistant

You need to correlate the coordinates of tracked devices and turn this information into usable data for other applications. Which real-time location service component accomplishes this task? A. location system B. BLE tag C. triangulation service D. location sensor

You are asked to perform a site survey on your enterprise by using a Juniper Access Point (AP) that is fully functional and visible by the Juniper Mist cloud. Your enterprise provides you with the portable equipment for elevating the Juniper AP and a battery that properly powers it. In this scenario, how would you ensure that the Juniper AP will be fully functional for site survey purposes? A. You will need to enable AP Config Persistence and disable AP Uplink Monitoring in the site configuration to force the Juniper AP to remember its configuration regardless of an Internet connection or not. B. You will need to enable Site Survey Mode in the site configuration to force the Juniper AP to remember its configuration regardless of an Internet connection or not. C. A Juniper AP will maintain its configuration by default as long as the Wi-Fi Assurance license has not expired. D. A Juniper AP will maintain its configuration by default once rebooted regardless of an Internet connection or not.
Which pair of Wireless Assurance SLEs have a classifier on DHCP? A. Roaming and Coverage B. Time to Connect and Roaming C. Coverage and Throughput D. Successful Connects and Time to Connect
At which signal strength level range will an extra AP placed on the same channel cause co-channel contention? A. -45 dBm to -65 dBm B. -55 dBm to -80 dBm C. -25 dBm to -80 dBm D. -65 dBm to -85 dBm

You are designing security around your wireless network and need to create WxLAN policies for Juniper Mist that require new policy labels. At which two levels would you be able to create policy labels in this scenario? (Choose two.) A. organization B. WLAN C. AP D. site
By default, Marvis Minis runs automatic tests at which interval? A. every 30 minutes B. every 24 hours C. every 5 minutes D. every 60 minutes
Which IEEE amendment covers radio resource management? A. 802.11ac B. 802.11b C. 802.11r D. 802.11k

Which statement is true about passive scanning for access point (AP) discovery? A. The client waits and listens for beacon frames advertised by an AP. B. The client must send a probe request to discover nearby APs. C. The client can use wildcards to try to discover all nearby APs that responds. D. The client sends a probe request to a specific service set identifier (SSID).

You want to verify that DHCP is working as expected on a WLAN that currently has no clients. In this scenario, which Marvis feature would you use to accomplish this task? A. Marvis Virtual Network Assistant B. Marvis Minis C. Marvis Query Language D. Marvis Actions

You discover that some clients do not use all channels in the 5 GHz UNII-2 Extended frequency band and you have made the appropriate adjustments in the RF template. How do you implement these changes? A. Optimize the frequency by selecting Optimize Now. B. Restart the WLANs. C. Restart the APs. D. Restart the clients.

A client has a poor Wi-Fi experience when moving around in an office. In this scenario, which Marvis Query Language clause would help troubleshoot the problem? A. STATUSOF B. ROAMINGOF C. UTILIZATIONOF D. RANK

Click the Exhibit button. You are asked to deploy a new Juniper Mist Edge VM for your customer. Referring to the exhibit, which three interfaces are required to accomplish this task? (Choose three.) A. out-of-band B. downstream C. proxy D. upstream E. revenue

Administrators need to gather information regarding client dwell time and how clients move through a location. In this scenario, which real-time location service provides this capability? A. optimize workflow B. zone analytics C. wayfinding D. asset tracking

A malicious user tricks users by broadcasting the same SSID that matches the legitimate AP in your corporate network. How does Juniper Mist classify this type of AP? A. mesh AP B. neighbor AP C. honeypot AP D. rogue AP

You are asked to ensure that you use WLAN security settings that require SAE authentication. In addition, all unicast management frames must be encrypted to prevent man-in-the-middle attacks. Which WLAN security type will accomplish this behavior? A. WPA B. WPA2 enterprise C. WPA2 personal D. WPA3 personal

Click the Exhibit button. As your Juniper Access Point first receives power, you observe the LED as it attempts to join the cloud. The LED blinks amber twice. You reboot your switch and the AP. After about 50 seconds, the AP blinks amber seven times. Referring to the exhibit, what is happening in this scenario? A. At first, there was power to the AP but no link-level connectivity; when you rebooted, it came back on, it obtained a DHCP address and it was able to ping the default gateway, but the DNS was not working. B. At first, there was power to the AP but no link-level connectivity; when you rebooted, it came back on and you experienced a firewall problem. C. Your connection is being blocked by a firewall and some ports must be opened. D. At first, there was power to the AP but you could not get a DHCP address; when you rebooted, it came back on and it had a DHCP address, but it was not able to ping the default gateway.

You want to measure the signal power loss that occurs after leaving the AP. In this scenario, what is the mathematical method used to accomplish this task? A. inverse square law B. free space path loss C. received signal strength indicator D. signal-to-noise ratio
Which three accounts are available when using Guest Portal Authorization Methods? (Choose three.) A. Facebook B. Google C. Amazon D. LinkedIn E. Apple
Which SLE is predictive? A. Successful Connect B. Capacity C. Throughput D. Coverage

You want to tunnel VLAN traffic to and from the Juniper Mist Edge for selected wireless networks. In this scenario, which protocol does the Juniper Access Point use to accomplish this task? A. L2TPv3 B. IP-IP C. HTTPS D. GRE

You are asked to find the location of a BLE client. In this scenario, what is the required Juniper Mist license subscription service? A. User Engagement B. Wireless Assurance C. Asset Visibility D. Wired Assurance

From the Mist Marvis Minis dashboard you notice a failed test. When viewing the current test result, all tests passed except for the Application test. What would be a reason for the failed test? A. A firewall rule was implemented blocking the application. B. The switch attached to the AP performing the test has failed. C. SSID scheduling has disabled a user WLAN. D. The DNS lookup has failed.
Failures detected by Marvis Minis are reported under which Marvis Action? A. Switch B. Connectivity C. AP D. Clients

You are creating a Juniper Mist account. Which two statements are true in this scenario? (Choose two.) A. You need separate usernames and passwords to access the Juniper Mist dashboard and Juniper Mist support. B. You can access the Juniper Mist dashboards and Juniper Mist support using a single username and password. C. Creating a Juniper account does not require you to have a Juniper device. D. Creating a Juniper Mist account requires you to have a Juniper device.
Labels are created for which two configuration levels? (Choose two.) A. site B. AP C. location D. organization

Your Juniper Access Point has changed channels due to RADAR being observed on a DFS channel. This change is an example of which Juniper Mist RRM system? A. FCC compliance B. global optimization C. reinforcement learning D. event-driven

Click the Exhibit button. You notice that your site events show an unresponsive DHCP server in your network. You want to analyze the event by using the dynamic packet capture. Referring to the exhibit, how would you access the packet capture for further analysis in Wireshark? A. Verify the impacted site and use the corresponding organization event to fetch the automatically generated packet capture. B. Verify the impacted site and use the corresponding site event to fetch the automatically generated packet capture. C. Verify the impacted client and use the corresponding site event to fetch the automatically generated packet capture. D. Verify the impacted client and use the corresponding client event to fetch the automatically generated packet capture.

Click the Exhibit button. Your colleagues report that they are unable to browse tutorials needed for work located at youtube.com when using their BYOD devices. When using a guest device, they are able to access youtube.com. In this scenario, how would you allow BYOD colleagues to access youtube.com using the WxLAN policies? A. Delete the WxLAN policy for guests and add the guest label to the policy for BYOD. B. Move the WxLAN policy for guests above the policy for contractor. C. Delete the WxLAN policy for BYOD and add the BYOD label to the policy for guests. D. Move the WxLAN policy for BYOD above the policy for guests.
Which signal modulation scheme provides the highest data rate level for 802.11ax devices? A. 64 QAM B. 256 QAM C. 1024 QAM D. 4096 QAM

Which statement correctly describes the BLE Asset Visibility function of Juniper Mist’s location-based services? A. It is enabled by default. B. The AP BLE radio is in listen-only mode. C. It is included in the Wireless Assurance subscription. D. The AP BLE radio is in transmit mode.

How does a Juniper Access Point detect rogue and honeypot APs? A. The Juniper Access Point uses all of its radios simultaneously to detect rogue and honeypot APs. B. The Juniper Access Point detects rogue and honeypot APs only by communicating with its Layer 2 switch. C. The Juniper Access Point uses its radios in round-robin fashion to detect rogue and honeypot APs. D. The Juniper Access Point has a radio dedicated only for scanning and detecting rogue and honeypot APs.
According to a Juniper Networks, it is recommended that devices using Mist location-based services (LBS) have line-of-sight to how many APs? A. 1 B. 2 C. 4 D. 3
According to Juniper Networks, it is recommended that devices using Mist location-based services (LBS) have line-of-sight to how many APs? A. 4 B. 3 C. 1 D. 2

Click the Exhibit button. Referring to the exhibit, which two statements are true? (Choose two.) A. Clients connected to the same AP remain isolated from each other. B. All ARP broadcasts on the wired network are blocked from going out of the wireless interface. C. Clients connected to the same AP maintain communication with each other. D. All ARP broadcasts on the wired network are sent out of the wireless interface.
